rows.note: Use this as the everyday choice for the physical slice: a body part, injury, or sensation that hurts.

example.english: My foot was stepped on, and it was painful.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 goek3 bei2 jan4 caai2 dou2 hou2 tung3

rows.note: Choose this for emotional distress or severe suffering rather than a simple localized ache.

example.english: That period after my breakup was really painful.
example.traditional: 失戀嗰段時間真係好痛苦。
example.jyutping: sat1 lyun2 go2 dyun6 si4 gaan3 zan1 hai6 hou2 tung3 fu2

rows.note: Choose this when painful means laborious, demanding, or requiring a lot of effort.

example.english: Carrying all those boxes of books upstairs was really painful.
example.traditional: 搬晒咁多箱書上樓，真係辛苦。
example.jyutping: bun1 saai3 gam3 do1 soeng1 syu1 soeng5 lau4 zan1 hai6 san1 fu2

rows.note: Choose this for something very poor or bad, such as a terrible performance.

example.english: Their game was painful to watch.
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 coeng4 bo1 tek3 dak1 hou2 caa1
